headline_seed: U.S.-Iran Updates: Trump says Iran to "get a beating" as war expands with U.S.-Saudi strikes in Iraq - CBS News
draft_text: Iran's IRGC launched ballistic missiles at U.S. forces Tuesday. CENTCOM says all were intercepted. By Wednesday, Trump told reporters: "We're going to be hitting them very hard." CBS News and CNN confirm U.S. strikes began around 8 p.m. ET Wednesday.
